title: Android, Team Codes & Community Fixes Update
changes: Pokémon Duel Remake v0.4.0 expands the game to Android, introduces Team Codes for easily transferring teams between devices, improves the update system, and fixes several gameplay issues reported by players.
📱 ANDROID SUPPORT
Added native Android support for Pokémon Duel Remake.
The game can now be played directly on supported Android devices without requiring Winlator.
Added mobile touch controls designed to reproduce the game's mouse-based interface.
Single tap acts as a Left Click and double tap acts as a Right Click.
One-finger dragging moves the game cursor.
Holding one finger while dragging another allows scrolling through menus and lists.
Text fields now support the Android software keyboard.
Added clipboard support for easier text and Team Code entry on mobile.
Android players can play Online matches with PC players running the same game version.
🔗 TEAM CODES
Added Team Codes for easily sharing and transferring teams between devices.
Saved teams now include a copy button that automatically generates a Team Code and copies it to the clipboard.
Team Codes transfer the Team Name, Pokémon Figures, Plates and Evolution or Mega attachments.
Added an Import Team Code option to the Teams menu.
Valid imported teams are opened directly in the Team Builder so they can be reviewed and saved.
Added clipboard pasting support, making it easy to send a team between PC and Android through Discord, Messenger or another app.
Invalid or incompatible Team Codes are safely rejected instead of creating an unusable team.
🔄 UPDATE SYSTEM
Improved the updater architecture in preparation for Windows, macOS and Android releases.
Existing players using older PC builds can upgrade to v0.4.0 through the in-game updater without downloading the entire game again.
Added support for a permanent v0.4.0 compatibility bridge for older installations.
Future v0.4.x updates can use smaller update overlays instead of rebuilding the full compatibility patch each time.
Fresh v0.4.0 installations use a clean base build while remaining compatible with future updater patches.
⚔️ BATTLE & GAMEPLAY
Fixed 0-damage White and Gold Attacks incorrectly knocking out opposing Pokémon.
Attacks with 0 damage can no longer cause a normal damage-based knockout.
Moves that explicitly state that they knock out, send to the P.C., exclude or otherwise remove a Pokémon continue to apply their intended effects.
Restored Lucario EX's updated Silver Fist Ability from the original Pokémon Duel.
Silver Fist prevents Lucario EX from being knocked out by Gold Attacks from its battle opponents while Lucario is not affected by a special condition.
🃏 PLATES
Fixed Recycle not restoring every previously used Plate.
Recycle now correctly restores all applicable Plates except Recycle itself.
Fixed Plates such as Max Revive remaining unavailable after Recycle was used.
Improved the clearing of used and excluded Plate states when Recycle activates.
🎮 GENERAL
Updated remake-specific branding throughout the game to Pokémon Duel Remake.
Improved cross-platform compatibility between Windows, macOS and Android.
Various additional fixes and improvements based on player feedback.
